headline: Record backlog, still not profitable
chart_note: 52-week range: $176.77 - $254.35. Currently $213.17, roughly in the middle of its 52-week range.
why_today: Q2 revenue grew 8% YoY to $24.6B on 171 commercial deliveries, and total backlog hit a record $715B - but Boeing still posted a GAAP loss of $0.67 per share, underscoring the turnaround isn't finished yet.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Buy (28 analysts), average price target $274.85 implies nearly 29% upside
pro_2: 737 production ramping toward 52/month, management calls $10B in free cash flow "very attainable" over time
con_1: Still not profitable on a GAAP basis - the turnaround is real but not finished
con_2: $45.9B in consolidated debt against the backlog means execution risk still matters a lot here
